sentences.text: Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

The applicant seeks anticipatory bail in FIR/Case Crime No.123 of 2024 dated 03.03.2024, under
Section 420 Ipc, Police Station Pathri, District Haridwar.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the informant was induced to purchase some land so as to sell it to a third person at a higher price.
The informant gave `16 Lakhs to purchase the land, but sale-deed was not executed in his favour.
Subsequently, informant came to know that he has been cheated.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant is not the beneficiary; he has not received any money and there is no transaction with the applicant.
5. Learned counsel for the informant would submit that the applicant had induced the applicant to purchase the property.

6. State as well as the informant to file objections within four weeks.
7. List on 11.11.2024.
8.
Having

considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witness in the case.
Murtaza vs State Of Uttarakhand on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124130308/
1
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) He shall deposit his passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
If the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 13.09.2024
